Trip 06 NB timepoint S. Main/Third — AVL position logged 02:05 vs. 02:31 board time; timepoint exception, no deviation authorization on file.

Silent alarm activation received from onboard MDT/console on Bus 4177 (Block 512-OWL). No voice on channel. Repeated hail unanswered. AVL last position vicinity S. Main at Third Ave (Trip 06 northbound, en route to the 02:31 timepoint).

Emergency dispatch initiated per SOP-24. Rivergate PD and Rivergate Fire/EMS requested Code 3 to S. Main at Third Ave for ACTD Bus #4177, Block 512-OWL, Op badge 4417. RPD Comm acknowledged; EMS Rescue-12 and Engine-3 rolling.

Third hail to Op 4417 with no response. Silent-alarm audio channel held open; ambient sounds only. Farebox/APC log on Bus 4177 queued for download — onboard count pending morning pull. Passenger notification not sent — held pending on-scene assessment.
Notified Operations Duty Officer (S. Ruiz, on-call) of active alarm on Block 512-OWL and pending RPD/EMS arrival. Bus 4177 GPS stationary at S. Main / Third. Standing by on scene channel.

INCIDENT DECLARED by dispatcher W. Tran. Category A — bus collision at intersection of South Main Street and Third Avenue, downtown Rivergate. Reported involvement: fixed object (City street-light standard) and one pedestrian at adjacent bus stop. RPD Unit 4-Adam-12 on scene; EMS Rescue-12 on scene. Assigned operator: Badge 4417 (Keeler, R.) on Block 512-OWL, Vehicle 4177. Incident number ACTD-IR-2025-1018 opened; on-scene draft report to follow.
Safety Division duty pager (M. Okonkwo) and General Counsel duty pager (D. Farkas) alerted per Rule Book §7.03. Preservation hold entered on AVL/GPS track for Block 512-OWL for the service night.

EMS on-scene advises airlift request for pedestrian casualty; ground transport for onboard passengers (2 injured, 1 uninjured witness — corroborates on-scene passenger accounting). South Main closed between Second Ave and Fourth Ave by RPD.

Adjacent owl blocks (511, 514, 517) advised of Main Street closure; short-turn instructions issued via console. Block 512-OWL remaining scheduled trips 06 (NB completion) through 10 suspended pending vehicle recovery. Preliminary on-scene draft incident report (Tran) started.

RPD field supervisor advises Op badge 4417 (Keeler) taken into custody at scene following roadside PBT. Bus #4177 secured on-scene; wrecker requested via ACTD Fleet Ops for tow to Div. 3 secure yard hold.
County Crime Lab evidentiary blood draw performed on Op 4417 per RPD at Rivergate Regional Trauma Center holding area. ACTD BAT en route to complete DOT 49 CFR Part 655 post-accident testing.
ACTD BAT R. Ngo (BAT-4471) commenced DOT post-accident test screening on Op 4417. Chain-of-custody documentation to be filed with Compliance.
DOT post-accident test confirmation reading completed by BAT R. Ngo. Compliance packet closed out at scene.

Overnight owl dispatch shift end. Console hand-off to day dispatcher L. Park. Incident file ACTD-IR-2025-1018 open; on-scene draft incident report by W. Tran routed to Safety Division intake for supervisor review and final report.
